meta.description: Generate novel drug-like molecules using the GenMol NIM microservice. Use for de novo generation, scaffold decoration, motif extension, lead optimization, SAFE notation, QED or LogP ranking, hosted NVIDIA API calls, or local Docker deployment. GenMol takes SAFE notation in the smiles field, not ordinary SMILES.

recommendations.title: Add inline scaffold_to_safe helper or direct safe-mol usage example
recommendations.problem: scaffold_to_safe helper referenced in SAFE Input section but user must navigate to references/examples.md to see implementation
recommendations.root_cause: Progressive disclosure trades off immediate learnability for context efficiency
recommendations.fix: Add minimal inline example after scaffold decoration bullet: 'import safe as sf; safe_input = sf.encode(scaffold_smiles) + ".[*{10-15}]"' with note that scaffold_to_safe is a convenience wrapper in examples.md

recommendations.title: Clarify unique parameter default and implications
recommendations.problem: unique=False in request pattern may confuse users expecting deduplicated results; no explanation of when to use True vs False
recommendations.fix: Add to gotchas: 'unique=False returns all generated molecules including duplicates (faster); set unique=True for deduplicated analog libraries when exploring chemical space systematically'

recommendations.title: Document idempotency behavior for deterministic generation
recommendations.problem: No statement on whether same SAFE input with same parameters produces identical outputs across runs
recommendations.root_cause: Stochastic generation model; determinism expectations unclear
recommendations.fix: Add to Limits section: 'GenMol generation is stochastic; identical inputs may produce different molecules across runs. For reproducible results, save and version generated molecule libraries rather than regenerating.'
